archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST (Modified for Clinical AI)

monospace.usage: Data metrics, confidence percentages, latency values, agent execution logs.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Flat solid surfaces with crisp 1px borders (border-slate-200). NO glassmorphism to prevent visual refraction of clinical data. Crisp 'Neumorphism-lite' with very soft shadow-sm for interactive elements.
visual_enhancers.confidence_rings: Use SVG circle with stroke-dasharray for % indication. Green >85%, Amber 60-84%, Red <60%.
visual_enhancers.agent_execution: Animated pulsing dots and 'tracer' beams along the connection lines to show active agent step.
visual_enhancers.badges: Pill-shaped with slight background tint of the semantic color and darker text (e.g., bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700).
visual_enhancers.disclaimer: Persistent sticky banner at bottom or top: 'ACADEMIC DEMONSTRATION — NOT A CLINICAL DIAGNOSIS' in Amber or Slate background with high contrast text.

component_instructions.Layout: Left sidebar (dark bg-slate-900) with Phosphor Icons. Main content area with generous padding (p-6 to p-8).
component_instructions.Cards: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl shadow-sm p-6. Never use colored gradients inside clinical data cards.
component_instructions.Chatbot: Show execution timeline (Input Guardrail -> Intent Detected -> Agent -> Evidence -> Confidence -> Response). Evidence chips below AI responses. Use a distinct background (e.g., bg-slate-50) for AI messages vs User messages (bg-primary/10).
component_instructions.Medical_Imaging: Image container max-h-[60vh] with bounding box overlays (simulated via CSS border on absolute position divs). Include Prediction text and confidence rings.
component_instructions.Agent_Workflow: Interactive node-based visualizer. Use a library like reactflow to build a DAG (Directed Acyclic Graph) highlighting 'User Input', 'Guardrail', 'Orchestrator', 'Specialized Agents', 'Confidence Estimator', 'Review', 'Response'. Active node must pulse.
component_instructions.Tables: Dense layout, align numbers to right, use monospace font for IDs and Confidence %.
component_instructions.Clinician_Review: Dashboard with Approve / Reject / Request Second Review actions, highlighting pending items in a Ranked Workflow Queue.

layouts.Dashboard: Bento-style grid: 'North Star' metrics top row (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4). Ranked Workflow Queue (col-span-3), Activity Feed (col-span-1).
layouts.Spacing: Use p-6 inside cards. gap-6 for grid. Generous whitespace between logical sections to reduce cognitive load.

media.icons: @phosphor-icons/react (Duotone or Regular weight for a clinical, precise feel).

3d_libraries.Workflow_Graph: reactflow (or react-flow-renderer) for the agent node execution graph.
3d_libraries.Charts: recharts for Analytics page (LineChart for latency, BarChart for agent usage).

accessibility.contrast: Red/Green/Amber must have minimum 4.5:1 against their backgrounds. Use text-shadow if overlaying text on medical images.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Animations should be snappy (under 200ms) to feel responsive.
accessibility.data_testid: MANDATORY on all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='upload-mri-btn', data-testid='approve-review-btn').

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required fonts from Google Fonts: Manrope, IBM Plex Sans, JetBrains Mono.
Install @phosphor-icons/react, recharts, sonner, framer-motion, and reactflow (or @xyflow/react).
Create all components as .js or .jsx files, NOT .tsx.
Enforce strict clinical aesthetic: no playful emojis (use Phosphor icons instead), no heavy gradients. Rely on typography, white space, and crisp 1px borders.
Include the persistent medical disclaimer prominently at the bottom of the screen with fixed positioning.
Build a custom 'Confidence Ring' component using SVG for the Medical Imaging page.
Construct the AI Chatbot to show distinct Agent states: 'Input Guardrail checking...', 'Intent Detected', 'Agent Executing', 'Generating Response' visually above the message.
Do NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, overlays, or navbars.
Override tailwind globals in index.css with the provided CSS variables to ensure brand consistency.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not use generic centered layouts or simplistic gradients.
NEVER use emojis as icons. Always use the specified icon library.
Add transition effects to interactive elements (hover, focus) but exclude transforms from 'transition-all'.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Missing categories (especially logos/avatars) must use the provided fallback URLs; placeholder text is FORBIDDEN.
All components should be extracted properly and modular.
